info.title: opencode HttpApi
info.description: Experimental HttpApi surface for selected instance routes.

get.description: Read CPU and memory on demand. The first CPU sample is unknown; no background collector is started.
Inspect only cached Locations for pending permissions and forms. No transcript or new Location is loaded.
Return the server identity, connection URLs, paths, and readiness status.
Return the server's version, runtime, data paths, database (local size or remote host) and memory. Never a credential.

post.description: Create a short-lived, single-use code for a /auth/connect/:code pairing link.

delete.description: Invalidate an unused pairing link. Already paired sessions remain connected.

get.description: Redeem a pairing code. Browsers receive a session cookie and a redirect to the web app; requests that accept JSON receive a session token to use as the password.
Resolve the requested location or the server default location.

post.description: Shut down and rebuild every loaded location. Pending permissions and forms are cancelled; running sessions continue with fresh services at the next step boundary. Emits location.shutdown for client recovery and responds once all replacement builds settle.

get.description: Retrieve currently registered agents.
Retrieve a single currently registered agent.
Retrieve enabled server plugins and their current status.

post.description: Check one or all package plugins for available updates.
Update package plugins concurrently and notify active locations to reload them. Responds once every update has finished; fails when any update fails.

post.summary: Archive or restore a settled session

get.description: List Design sessions and their review state in a directory, newest first.

schema.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.
Session order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

anyOf.description: Filter by parent session. Use null to return only root sessions.
Opaque pagination cursor returned as cursor.previous or cursor.next in the previous response.

get.description: Retrieve sessions in the requested order. Items keep that order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered list.

post.description: Create a session at the requested location. A parentID creates a linked child session at its parent's location.

get.description: Aggregate local session activity, usage, and tool reliability for a time range.

post.description: Copy V2 assistant usage into the legacy-format local usage database.
Import a projected session transcript at the requested location. If parentID is supplied, the parent session must already exist; import parents before children.

get.description: Detect the local session stores of other coding agents whose sessions can be imported.

schema.description: Only return sessions recorded in this directory.
Maximum number of sessions to return. Defaults to the newest 50 sessions.

get.description: List the most recently updated top-level sessions in another coding agent's session store.

post.description: Import a session and its subagent sessions from another coding agent under their original IDs. The session binds to its recorded directory unless location is supplied. A session that was already imported fails with a conflict naming the existing session.

ref.description: The session identifier in the source store.

get.description: Export a complete projected session transcript.
Retrieve foreground Session drains currently owned by this OpenCode process. Sessions absent from the result are inactive.
Retrieve a session by ID.

delete.description: Delete a session and its child sessions.

get.description: Read the original user-message receipt and execution state in one snapshot, without conversation content. Does not admit or resume work.

post.description: Create or synchronize a public link for a session.

delete.description: Revoke the public link for a session.

post.description: Associate an imported share with its Console credential and organization, then verify it by synchronizing.

get.description: Manage monitors belonging to this session. Cancellation stops local observation; external jobs keep running.
Manage monitors belonging to this session. Cancellation stops local observation; external jobs keep running.

post.description: Manage monitors belonging to this session. Cancellation stops local observation; external jobs keep running.

get.description: Read persisted Redcode tasks, including blockers and completion evidence.

Read persisted tasks with their derived prerequisites, waiting dependencies and child-session assignments. This observation never starts, accepts or completes work and does not replace candidate verification.
get.summary: Inspect task dependencies and delegated assignments

get.description: Derive execution outcomes, source references, checks, overlapping files and acceptance for a task's prerequisites. This read never accepts or completes work.

post.description: Select current accepted prerequisite contributions from local managed worktrees, prepare a joint Git revision and persist its task/session/prompt provenance. Conflicts do not bind a candidate; preparation never verifies or completes tasks.
post.summary: Prepare and bind accepted task results

post.description: Record admission before applying the exact candidate SHA to its clean original target. Retrying an admitted request observes Git without replaying the mutation; uncertain outcomes remain pending.
post.summary: Apply the accepted and verified task candidate

get.description: Retrieve the goal and its current step budget, evidence, and review state.

post.description: Create a goal and admit an instruction to start working on it. An active goal must be paused before replacement.
Pause, resume, drop, or change the step, cost, and token budget of the current goal. Pause and drop interrupt local execution; resume admits work.

Read what the user typed after /goal without acting on it. An explicit subcommand (set, pause, resume, drop, budget, status) resolves directly. Other text is read by System One in dual reasoning; a reading that would drop or replace an unfinished goal below 0.85 confidence, or any other reading below 0.7, returns options to ask the user instead of an action. Without a reading the text is a new goal only when no goal is unfinished.

get.description: Read the cost and token limits in force and total provider usage by this session and its children.

patch.description: Set or clear cost and token limits for this session. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null removes a limit.

get.description: Replay the session's durable conversation as Design review events and continue live.
Read Design documents in this session, including documents imported from Redcode V1.

post.description: Create an isolated Design prototype for this session and discover its application design system.

get.description: Read one Design document from this session.

patch.description: Update a Design document; note status changes require the V1 verification rules and configured semantic review.

get.description: Read durable render and verification jobs for a Design document.

post.description: Rediscover the application's design system and refresh its generated manifest.
Freeze an explicitly approved Design revision and continue its Session in Plan unless its goal stops after Design.
Reopen a review after an explicit user request while retaining its approved revision.

get.description: Read immutable Design revisions imported from Redcode V1.
Read admitted browser feedback retained with a Design document.
Read the versioned asset metadata retained with a Design document.
Read one immutable Design revision and its file manifest.

post.description: Create a child session by copying projected history before a message. Omit before to copy the full history.
Switch the agent used by subsequent provider turns.
Switch the model used by subsequent provider turns.
Move a session to another project directory at the requested delivery boundary.
Durably admit one session input and schedule agent-loop execution unless resume is false.
Execute a slash command callback immediately.
Activate a skill for a session by appending a skill message and resuming execution.
Durably admit synthetic session input and schedule execution unless resume is false.
Execute one shell command in the session's working directory. Emits a shell.started event before execution and a shell.ended event with the merged output after.
Durably admit a session compaction request. Steers by default: it runs at the next step boundary instead of waiting behind queued prompts.

focus.description: What the summary should cover in the most detail. Ignored when a pending compaction absorbs this request.

post.description: Wait for a session agent loop to become idle.
Stage or move a reversible session boundary and optionally apply its file changes.

get.description: Retrieve the active context messages for a session (all messages after the last compaction).

schema.description: Compare the whole session from its first user message through its latest. Cannot be combined with from or to.
User message whose turn to diff. Defaults to the turn of the newest user message.
Later user message whose turn ends the range. Defaults to the turn of `from` alone.
Unchanged lines around each hunk. Omit for full-file patches.

get.description: Structured per-file diffs of the files a turn changed. A turn runs from the first prompt after the session was last idle until its next idle marker, so prompts steered in while it was busy belong to the same turn; `to` extends the range through a later turn. Compares the range's first recorded snapshot with its last; a step still running in the active session compares against the working copy. Ranges that span a location change are rejected. In sessions without any idle marker, a prompt's turn spans until the next user message.
List durable enqueued session work not yet delivered, ordered by enqueue sequence. Includes user, synthetic, compaction, and move items.

delete.description: Cancel an inbox item that has not yet been delivered. Unavailable items are a no-op.

patch.description: Change a pending inbox item's delivery mode. Steering wakes session execution.

get.description: List API-managed instruction entries attached to the session.

put.description: Attach or replace one durable instruction entry. Changes announce as updates at the next step boundary.

delete.description: Remove one instruction entry; the removal is announced to the model at the next step boundary.

post.description: Generate transient text from the current session context without mutating session history.

get.description: Experimental durable session event log. Reads events after an exclusive aggregate sequence and continues with live events when follow=true.

post.description: Schedule the process-local drain of an existing Session without admitting input or interrupting active execution. Wakeups coalesce; acceptance does not confirm completion or clustered ownership.

Interrupt active execution owned by this OpenCode process. Returns interrupted=true when an active execution was interrupted and false for the idle no-op. When resume=true, execution resumes pending steering input and next-in-line control items (manual compaction, moves) while queued prompts remain parked.
Move active foreground backgroundable tools for this session into background observation. Idle requests are a no-op.

get.description: Retrieve one projected message owned by the Session.
Retrieve pending forms for a session.

get.description: Retrieve a form and its current state for a session.

post.description: Submit an answer to a pending form.

put.description: Replace the process environment used by local shell commands for this session.

post.description: Mark the idle transition observed by the viewer as viewed.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, the endpoint returns its default page size.
Message order for the first page. Use desc for newest first or asc for oldest first.

schema.description: Filter by message type before pagination. When omitted, all message types are returned. Pass the same type when following cursors.

get.description: Retrieve projected messages for a session, optionally filtered by type. Items keep the requested order across pages; use cursor.next or cursor.previous to move through the ordered timeline, passing the same type filter on each page.
Retrieve the current snapshot of available models ordered by release date. The snapshot may precede initial plugin settlement.
Retrieve the model used when a session has no explicit model selection.

post.description: Run one stateless model generation using the server's base configuration and return the assistant text. Uses the base configuration's default model when none is specified.

Retrieve a single AI provider so clients can inspect its availability and endpoint settings.

Probe the active account and report upstream HTTP status, elapsed time, received body bytes and catalog size.

Retrieve one integration and its authentication methods.

Read the last physical rows without changing selection or taking control. Omitted lines uses the live terminal height; larger counts include retained history. Blank rows are preserved. system.description: The project's design system that previews reuse: component roots, stylesheets and CSS pipeline

application.description: Project-relative directory of the application package the design system belongs to, such as apps/web in a monorepo. design_document create uses it when no application is named; system paths are relative to it. It is read together with system from the same configuration document: a document that sets system without application drops an application set elsewhere, and an application set without system is ignored while another document supplies system.

browser.description: Browser that opens Design review pages: "default" for the system browser, "chrome" or "chromium" for that installed browser, "app" for a Chrome or Chromium app window (--app), an app name, or an executable path. Equivalent to REDCODE_DESIGN_BROWSER, which wins when both are set. Default: Chrome or Chromium when installed, else the system browser.

breakpoints.description: Viewport widths in CSS pixels that web designs are reviewed and audited at, narrowest first. Default: [390, 768, 1440]. App designs use phone presets and presentations 1920×1080 instead.

viewports.description: Viewport classes the layout audit covers: "mobile" (up to 640px), "compact" (up to 1024px) and "desktop". Default: every class the target is reviewed at. Unknown names are ignored, and a list naming no known class, or leaving the target without a viewport, keeps every class.

gate.description: Require a completed layout audit of the published revision at every viewport class in design.viewports before a Design can be approved. Default: false.

mode.description: Where Design builds, renders, exports and serves its review when redcode runs from source: "process" runs them in the design app (redcode-design), a separate process redcode starts on demand and that exits after ten idle minutes; "inline" runs them inside redcode. Default: "inline". Installed redcode always uses the design app and ignores this setting.

version.description: Deprecated and ignored: the design app now ships with redcode in the same release, so redcode always runs the one installed beside it. Kept so existing configurations still validate; REDCODE_DESIGN_BIN overrides the binary.

app.description: The design app process that serves Design's review surface and runs its heavy work

directory.description: Parent directory for new worktrees, relative to the project's primary checkout when not absolute

auto.description: Move a writing session into its own worktree before its first source edit or build command (default: true)

location.description: Place automatic worktrees inside the repository or under the temporary directory

tmpdir.description: Temporary parent directory for automatic worktrees when location is tmp

paths.description: Project-relative component and token roots of the design system. Declaring a root is a standing read grant for design builds: design_preview asks once for the declared roots and stylesheets, the tooling configuration and the project's node_modules, and later preview builds import from them without a per-file prompt. Symlinks escaping a declared root are still refused, and a package linked to a source tree outside node_modules (a workspace package) must be declared here; "." grants the whole project.

css.description: Project-relative stylesheets included in every preview. The html engine links a built copy; react and solid entries import them before the prototype's own code.

tailwind.description: Run the project's PostCSS pipeline (postcss.config.*, or tailwindcss with autoprefixer synthesized from tailwind.config.*) in preview builds so Tailwind utilities used by the prototype are generated. This executes those configuration files in the redcode process, so design_preview asks a separate project_tooling permission naming them; when it is refused the preview builds without the pipeline. Default: enabled when tailwind.config.* exists and tailwindcss is a dependency. Tailwind v4 needs an explicit true.

framework.description: Component framework of the declared roots. Default: detected from package.json dependencies.

aliases.description: Extra import aliases for preview builds, mapping an import prefix to a project-relative directory, applied on top of the tsconfig paths.

anyOf.description: Reuse a randomly selected provider until it is rate limited, then switch to another available provider.

Design.SystemDescription.description: Design-system notes as text or structured JSON, including application, framework, components and tokens.

value.description: JSON value attached to the session's instructions

Mcp.Protocol.description: MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.

name.description: The executable name, matched exactly (case-insensitively and without .exe on Windows).

match.description: Default "name". "cmdline" matches a process whose command line contains name.

expect_status.description: Status code(s) that count as up. Default: any 2xx.

headers.description: Request headers. A value may use {env:NAME}; sending each variable to this host needs its own env permission.

start.description: Startup script to run when creating a new workspace (worktree)

interrupted.description: Whether an active execution owned by this OpenCode process was interrupted.

started.description: Start time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch

revision.description: The revision you were shown for this task; omit it from an update to apply against the stored revision, and a supplied revision that no longer matches is refused

title.description: Short one-line label shown in the task list: imperative, at most 80 characters. Put the full task and its acceptance detail in content

content.description: The full task the model works from

status.description: pending, in_progress, blocked, completed, cancelled; historical snapshots may contain other values

priority.description: Priority level of the task: high, medium, low
